However, the comment merely points out the similarity to prior work without offering any concrete improvement suggestions or guidance on how the authors could distinguish their novelty, so it provides only minimal actionable guidance. The claim that authors can directly address the novelty claim by clarifying differences or repositioning their work is an inference not supported by the comment itself, which contains no such suggestions. The feedback identifies a weakness but is limited in depth and offers little direction for improvement, placing it at a level where the weakness is identified but guidance remains minimal rather than clear and comprehensive.
